mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 64 degree temperatures with overcast skies at Verona Community Park.

The City has announced pavement repairs for November 9 and 10 on North Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street. Also, we are pleased to welcome Deputy Chief Liz Gay to the EMS team, who joins us with a strong background in public safety leadership.

There is plenty to do this week with trivia tonight at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, and live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I offence after finding him in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is Turtle Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open, so stop by before they close at 10 PM.
